items.headline: Smart is looking for No. 2 Georgia to 'continue to get better' against Western Kentucky
items.description: — Coach Kirby Smart realized an explanation might be needed when he said his goal for No. 2 Georgia in Saturday's game against Western Kentucky was to “continue to get better.”

items.headline: Jones, Kelley help Nevada cruise past Western Kentucky 49-14 in a season opener
items.description: — Carter Jones threw a pair of touchdown passes, Dominic Kelley scored two touchdowns, including a 72-yard touchdown run, and Nevada beat Western Kentucky 49-14 on Saturday night in the season opener for both teams.
